summary.text: In September and October 2025, Bessent described AI as one contributor to national prosperity and anticipated major gains in investment, productivity, and job growth. In June 2026, he linked effective AI deployment to the next era of economic growth and supported regulatory approaches enabling responsible adoption in finance. In September 2026 testimony, he opposed liability exemptions for AI labs and argued that holding creators responsible would promote safety.
